summary: Expand the experience from a single-page romantic Chocolate Day interaction to a multi-page flow with additional sweet/romantic messages, a virtual “box full of chocolates” gifting element, and an added final page showing multiple chocolate pictures with short “meaning” love lines for each.
architectural_notes: Scope change: move from single-page experience to a multi-page flow to present additional messages and gifting content.
Scope update: add an extra final step/page that reintroduces multiple chocolate items (with image + meaning text) after the current last page.
Update the final “chocolate meanings” step content structure to support per-item copy placed before and/or after the chocolate image (e.g., ‘my only…’ line above, continuation below).
known_issues: Potential scope conflict: existing request to restrict selection to only “Dairy Milk Fruit & Nut” vs new request to add multiple chocolates on a new final page.
Production deployment failed with a deployment error; user requested a redeploy/retry.

existing_features.title: Create a single-page Chocolate Day experience that feels unique, romantic, colorful, and professionally designed, centered around the recipient’s favorite chocolate: “Dairy Milk Fruit & Nut”.

Add a clickable chocolate gallery (card/grid layout) that includes at minimum one item labeled “Dairy Milk Fruit & Nut” plus additional chocolate options; clicking any chocolate image reveals a romantic text message for that specific chocolate.

Implement a romantic ‘reveal’ interaction that feels special (e.g., animated modal with soft transitions, confetti/hearts accent, or elegant flip-card reveal) while keeping the UI accessible (keyboard operable, readable contrast, focus states).

Add a cohesive visual theme for the entire page (colors, typography, spacing, background treatment) aligned to a romantic, colorful aesthetic (avoid blue/purple-dominant palettes) and apply it consistently across all components.
Add the required generated images as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated and use them in the chocolate gallery (no backend image serving).
Update the chocolate gallery data to include only one chocolate option: “Dairy Milk Fruit & Nut”, and remove the other chocolate options from the interactive experience.
Adjust user-facing copy in the page and gallery to reflect that there is only one favorite chocolate (singular phrasing), without referencing multiple chocolates or a “collection”.
Update the gallery layout so the single chocolate card is presented in a visually balanced way (e.g., centered on larger screens) rather than leaving an empty multi-column grid.

Convert the current single-page Chocolate Day experience into a simple multi-page (multi-step) flow within the frontend, with clear Next/Back navigation and a visible progress indicator, while keeping the existing Dairy Milk Fruit & Nut reveal interaction available in the flow.

Add additional romantic/sweet message content across the subsequent pages that praises the recipient (e.g., how sweet he is), using English user-facing text and keeping the tone romantic and heartfelt.

Add a “virtual chocolates” gifting experience as a dedicated page/step featuring a visually rich ‘box full of chocolates’ view (open box with assorted chocolates), including a small romantic note for him.
Integrate the required new static image assets for the virtual chocolate box experience under frontend/public/assets/generated and use them in the new gifting step/page (no backend image serving).

Update the user-facing closing message on the last step (VirtualChocolateGiftStep) to remove the phrase “my sweet friend” and instead address the recipient as the user’s boyfriend/partner/soulmate (optionally also acknowledging he is her closest/best friend) using English text.

Add a new step to the Chocolate Day multi-step flow that visually mimics the style of the uploaded Instagram screenshots: a tall, story-like “shareable card” with a bold header line, a centered faux browser/laptop frame, a cute stationery/paper background, small sticker/doodle accents, and a prominent message centered around the existing favorite chocolate “Dairy Milk Fruit & Nut”.
Update the step flow to include the new Instagram-style card step in navigation and progress, increasing the total step count accordingly and ensuring Back/Next controls work for all steps.

Implement the new Instagram-style card step as a dedicated React component under the existing steps folder and ensure it uses static assets for its background/frame/stickers from frontend/public/assets/generated (no backend image serving).

Add a new final step page after the current last step (after VirtualChocolateGiftStep) that displays multiple chocolate pictures, each paired with a short romantic “meaning” message, using English user-facing text.

Update the multi-step flow to include the new final step in step rendering, progress indicator, and Back/Next navigation by increasing the total step count and ensuring navigation works across all steps.

Create a dedicated React step component under frontend/src/components/chocolate-day/steps for the new “chocolate meanings” page and style it consistently with the existing romantic theme (cards/grid, soft shadows, rounded corners, warm rose/pink/amber palette).
Add new static image assets for the chocolates shown on the new final step under frontend/public/assets/generated and reference them directly from the new step (no backend image serving).

Update the final step component (frontend/src/components/chocolate-day/steps/ChocolateMeaningsStep.tsx) to include additional chocolates with the exact user-requested romantic lines and the specified text-before/after-image formatting, using English user-facing text.

Add these new chocolates to the Chocolate Meanings content:
- Centre Fresh: message text exactly "You gave freshness in my life"
- Dark Fantasy: show "My only dark fantasy" first, then the Dark Fantasy image, then show "It will be with you forever" below the image
- Kinder Joy: show "My love for you is unlimited, just like" first, then the Kinder Joy image, then show "Surprises" below the image
- Dairy Milk (use the existing Dairy Milk Fruit & Nut image): render the sentence as a text–image–text line: "You're the" + [image] + "that makes my life sweeter"
- Milky Way: show "Our relationship is just like" first, then the Milky Way image, then add a short romantic continuation line in English below the image that completes the thought

Keep the existing Chocolate Meanings page styling consistent with the current romantic theme (cards/grid, soft shadows, rounded corners, warm rose/pink/amber palette), and ensure the layout remains responsive and readable on mobile.
Add new static chocolate images for the newly requested chocolates under frontend/public/assets/generated and reference them from ChocolateMeaningsStep (no backend image serving).

Add a few more chocolates (at least 3 additional items beyond those explicitly listed by the user) to the Chocolate Meanings step, each with an image and a short romantic 'reason I love you' line in English, keeping the same visual style and ensuring the page remains balanced (no overcrowding).
Publish the current latest version of the Chocolate Day app to production and provide the user with the updated public URL to access it.
Retry deploying the current latest version of the Chocolate Day application to production via the platform deployment flow, and provide the updated public production URL once deployment succeeds.
After a successful deployment, update frontend/PRODUCTION_URL.txt to replace the placeholder URL and timestamp with the actual production URL and the time of update (English text only).

Restrict the chocolate selection to only “Dairy Milk Fruit & Nut” (no additional chocolate options in the gallery).
Add additional romantic/sweet messages across subsequent pages (multi-page flow) praising the recipient (e.g., how sweet he is).
Add a virtual chocolates gifting experience, such as a “box full of chocolates” view/interaction for him.
Update last page copy to remove the phrase “my friend” and refer to the recipient as boyfriend/partner/soulmate (closest best friend, soulmate, partner, boyfriend, everything).
Add a new page after the current last step that displays multiple chocolate pictures (e.g., Choco Pie, KitKat, Fuse, Gems, 5 Star) each paired with a short romantic “meaning”/message line.

Expand the final “chocolate meanings” step to include additional chocolates (Centre Fresh, Dark Fantasy, Kinder Joy, Milky Way, plus Dairy Milk) with specific romantic reason/meaning lines in the requested text-before/after-image format.
